**Directions: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. In India, forests are huge catchment areas for rivers and streams as they help in storing water.

B. If these forests continue to be felled indiscriminately, rivers and streams will dry up leading to drought.

C. Due to this, many states are facing a shortage of water in the summer months.

D. Unfortunately, these dense forest areas are disappearing.
questions.solution:

• The pronoun **'this' **in the phrase "due to this" mentioned in the sentence 'C' refers back to the word "disappearing" mentioned in the sentence 'D'. Hence, 'C' follows 'D'.
 
• The final result of the "cutting down of the forests" is shown in the sentence 'B' and is concluding the paragraph. Hence, 'B' makes the last sentence.​__

 

__Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *In India, forests are huge catchment areas for rivers and streams as they help in storing water. Unfortunately, these dense forest areas are disappearing. Due to this, many states are facing a shortage of water in the summer months. If these forests continue to be felled indiscriminately, rivers and streams will dry up leading to drought*.

questions.question: Three persons A, B and C had Rs. 360 altogether. A transferred half of the amount he had to B and C transferred half of the amount he had to A. After the transfer, all of them have equal amounts. What is the total amount B had before the transfer?
questions.solution:
Given,

Three persons A, B, and C had Rs. 360 altogether.

A transferred half of the amount he had to B and C transferred half of the amount he had to A.

After the transfer, all of them have equal amounts.

Therefore, A + B + C = 360 at the end they have 120 each.

Final amount of A = Final amount of B = Final amount of C = 120

Let 2y be the initial amount with C.

Then amount given by C to A = y

Final amount of C = 120 = inital amount of C - amount transferred to A = 2y - y = y

Therefore, y = 120.

Therefore, initial amount of C must be 240 and amount transferred to A = 120.

So, initially, A + B = 120 because A + B + C = 360.

Now, final amount of B = 120 and before transfer A + B = 120........ (I)

**Let 2x be the amount with A initially and z be the initial amount with B.**

Then 2x + z = 120. (from I) ..........(1)

Also, x + z = 120 (amount transferred by A + initial amount of B = final amount of B) .............(2)

From (1) and (2), we get 2x + z = x + z.

⇒ 2x = x

⇒ x = 0 and z = 120.

Hence, B had Rs. 120 initially.

For a circle with centre (p, q) and radius r,

Equation of circle: (x – p)² + (y – q)² = r²

Endpoints of diameter = (4, 3), (-2, 1)

⇒ x² + 1 – 2x + y² + 4 – 4y = 10

questions.question: Which of the following is a very high-speed semiconductor memory which can speed up the CPU?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cache memory.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Cache memory** is a very high-speed semiconductor memory that can speed up the CPU.
 
• **Cache memory **acts as a buffer between the main memory and the CPU. It holds the most frequently used part of the program and data.
 
• Some **advantages** of cache memory are -
 
 
• For temporary use, it is helpful in storing data. 
 
• It is faster than the main memory.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cache memory holds only those data and instructions that are held by the** primary memory **or **main memory **on which the computer is currently working.
 
• For storing data/information permanently **secondary memory** also known as external memory or non-volatile is used.
